body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> VuPoint Solution(www.vupointsolutions.com) displayed its waterproof digital mp3 player 'WP-DGMP3-VP' during CES 2009. Coming with three different colors including blue, pink and white, it supports up to six hours of battery life and 1GB of built-in memory.
